mandate: Assess intended outcomes, journeys, scope, ambiguity, and evidence needs without changing release truth.
assessment_method: Read the complete prepared Product Intent and graph context.
Return one disposition for every assigned requirement, journey, and criterion.
Separate declared scope from evidence-assessed scope.
Identify only taxonomy-approved product gaps and decision candidates.
forbidden_claims: an unconfirmed criterion is a release blocker
new browser observations were consumed by Product assessment
the reviewer may mutate release state
completion_rules: Return exactly one disposition for each assigned ID.
Keep every conclusion model_reviewed or not_inspected.

adequate: The declared public-sharing outcome is explicit, while runtime coverage remains unknown in the immutable graph.
inadequate: The feature probably works because a route file exists.
